svg.text: Jetson AGX Orin developer kit, 40-pin header
Seen facing the header: pin 1 is at the top right, marked by a white triangle on the PCB; odd pins
on the top row, numbers rising to the left. Pin numbers are BOARD numbers, as in Jetson.GPIO.
7.4 V side: see the power figure.

Pins: yellow outline = in use. Colours: 5 V red, 3.3 V orange, GND green, I2C blue, GPIO purple, other grey.
